[[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],In the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]], Rex states that he is ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old. ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the novel in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], thereby dating Rex's [[Reproduction/Legends|birth]] year to circa [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Kamino[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]] |death= |species=[[Human/Legends|Human]] ([[Cloning/Legends|clone]]) |gender=[[Gender/Legends|Male]] |pronouns=He/him |donor=[[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] |height=1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] |mass=80 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]]''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Head-to-Head]]'' |hair=[[Color/Legends|Black]];{{Film|II}} light blond (bleached){{SW|url=video/the-clone-wars-the-clones-are-coming|text=The Clone Wars: The Clones are Coming}} |feathers= |eyes=Brown[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] |skin=Tan |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] **[[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|I used to believe that being a good soldier meant doing everything they told you. That's how they engineered us. But we're not droids. We're ''not'' programmed. You have to learn to make your ''own decisions''.|Captain Rex|{{TCW|Carnage of Krell}}}} '''Rex''' was a veteran [[Clone Captain/Legends|clone trooper captain]] who led the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] acclaimed [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Cloning/Legends|Bred]] and trained on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], he was designated '''CT-7567''' and entered into [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] service at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. He gained respect from [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] and [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] alike as an honorable [[Commander/Legends|commander]], becoming known as one of the best and toughest clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] in the Grand [[Army/Legends|Army]]. He was even selected for special [[ARC program/Legends|command training]] under [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Alpha (Advanced Recon Commando)|Alpha]], following which he took the name Rex. As the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the 501st, Rex served as second-in-command to [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], whose bravery and unorthodoxy in battle he came to share. He was close friends with [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Marshal Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], with their relationship mirroring that of their respective Jedi [[General/Legends|Generals]], Skywalker and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. The four of them often received joint assignments to coordinate front-line campaigns against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. At the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]], Rex became a mentor to Skywalker's newly assigned [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], with whom he forged a strong bond. He also managed to rebound from the following [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]], an [[Ground warfare/Legends|engagement]] he would never forget due to the near-complete eradication of his 501st [[Company/Legends|unit]], [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]]. While on a [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] inspection tour with Cody, Rex rallied a small team of rookie [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] to [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|retake]] [[Rishi Station/Legends|Rishi Station]], which they thereafter destroyed to thwart Confederate General [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] planned invasion of Kamino. He was soon deployed on tour aboard Skywalker's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], and joined Skywalker and Tano in leading 501st offensives at [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], [[Battle of JanFathal|JanFathal]], and other flashpoints across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. He took part in countless campaigns in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] theater of war, from the [[Raid on Nuvo Vindi's laboratory/Legends|containment]] of the [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|liberation]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] to other hard-won victories like the [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|Battle of Malastare]], the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]], and the [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|Battle of Kamino]]. Throughout his career, Rex proved to be an effective leader who truly cared for the men under his command, even as he began to doubt his own future—and those of his clone brethren—in the Republic. The [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|Battle of Saleucami]] of [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] saw him meet the clone deserter [[Cut Lawquane/Legends|Cut Lawquane]], whom he came to respect despite their striking differences. His leadership was put to the ultimate test at the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]], when he was forced to unite the 501st [[Legion/Legends|Legion]] under an interim Jedi General, the obstinate and aggressive [[Pong Krell/Legends|Pong Krell]]. Rex did not see [[Eye/Legends|eye]]-to-eye with Krell and found himself having to balance his [[Troop/Legends|troops']] well-being with Krell's high-[[Death/Legends|casualty]] plans. When Krell manipulated the 501st into a fatal confrontation with their comrades from the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]], Rex realized their general was a traitor to the Republic, and he risked charges of [[Treason/Legends|treason]] to lead his men in arresting Krell. The ordeal refined his hard-line obedience to orders, as he also learned the value of making his own decisions as a soldier. Rex's unwavering dedication to the Republic kept him on the front lines over the three-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] span of the Clone Wars. He aided Skywalker, Tano, and Kenobi in [[Battle of Kadavo/Legends|rescuing]] [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] colonists from the [[Zygerrian Slave Empire/Legends|Zygerrian Slave Empire]] and, in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], offered his soldier's expertise to help the Jedi train [[Onderon rebels/Legends|local insurgents]] on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] to [[Battle of Onderon/Legends|emancipate]] their world. In a stark turn of events, he and Skywalker [[Capture of Ahsoka Tano/Legends|apprehended]] Tano on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] after she was framed for a [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|bombing]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], an incident that culminated in her departure from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. In addition, Rex and Skywalker [[Mission to Level 1325/Legends|gave pursuit]] of a longtime comrade, ARC trooper [[Fives/Legends|Fives]], who had gone rogue after unearthing an [[Order 66/Legends|anti-Jedi directive]] that had been [[Inhibitor chip/Legends|bred]] into all of the Republic's clone troopers. Before Fives could prove his findings to Rex and Skywalker, the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] gunned him down for resisting arrest. By war's [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|end]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Rex ceded his command over the 501st to another officer, Commander [[Appo/Legends|Appo]], who oversaw the unit into the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. ==Biography== ===A number and a name=== ====Training and Geonosis==== {{Quote|He's wound tight, but he's loyal.''"
"''He kind of reminds me of you.''"
"''Maybe… back in the day.|Rex and Anakin Skywalker, on rookie trooper Dogma|{{TCW|Darkness on Umbara}}}} A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the acclaimed [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], Rex was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] as a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] with the designation CT-7567 around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] for service in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Granted advanced growth by the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] cloners, he was part of one of the first batches of clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]],{{FactFile2014|69|REX 1-4|Captain Rex}} and his early life largely incorporated Kaminoan [[flash training]]. As was the case with other clones who became [[Officer/Legends|officers]], the Kaminoans spotted his natural leadership abilities early on, and over the next [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]], he was put through additional command training and intensive programmed learning to develop his skills.''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'' By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he had begun training as a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] leader. That same year,''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' CT-7567 served on the planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]{{TCW|Duel of the Droids|d=y}} in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|opening battle]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]'' [[Ground warfare/Legends|fighting]] on the side of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] against the native [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] and the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. He survived the First Battle of Geonosis''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide]]'' and continued his Grand [[Army/Legends|Army]] service in the resultant [[The galaxy/Legends|intergalactic]] conflict, swearing to defend all Republic citizens from harm{{CN|url=tv_shows/starwars/?episodeID=8a2505961f130e41011f236f7ae00006|text=Dataclip: Trespass|na=video file}} as part of his oath of loyalty to the Republic state.{{TCW|The Deserter}} He served with [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] on multiple occasions and learned to respect their [[Force power/Legends|abilities]]; in turn, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] officers came to rely on him. Thanks to his aggression on the battlefield, he earned a reputation as one of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military's]] best and toughest clone troopers.''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]'' Such was his prowess and performance that he was withdrawn from his unit and was among the 100 clone officers recalled to Kamino to undergo specialized [[ARC program/Legends|command training]].{{FactFile2013|2|COD 1-4|Commander Cody}} [[File:Anakin_and_Rex_on_Christophsis.png|thumb|left|300px|Rex became identical to his assigned Jedi General, Anakin Skywalker, in many ways.]] Under the hardened [[Eye/Legends|eye]] of [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Alpha (Advanced Recon Commando)|Alpha]], CT-7567 and his fellow [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] endured grueling exercises to develop independent thought, improvisation, and individuality.{{DB|organization|clonetroopers|clone troopers}} The ARC program led CT-7567 to befriend another officer, [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Marshal Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|CC-2224]]. After Alpha rewarded their individualism by granting them proper names, CT-7567 and CC-2224 became known as Rex and Cody, respectively, with the former keeping the origins of his nickname to himself. Rex often found himself working with Cody, particularly in a number of dangerous campaigns. One example was the [[Battle of Tibrin]], in which they tried and failed alongside several Jedi to oust a [[Confederacy military/Legends|Separatist military]] presence from [[Tibrin/Legends|Tibrin]]. Although the battle was a crushing Republic defeat, Rex and Cody managed to survive.{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}}{{FactFile2014|32|GRE 1-4|Clone Commander Gree}} ====Early Clone Wars==== Within several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] of the First Battle of Geonosis,''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' Rex, having become well respected by clones and Jedi officers alike,{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/webstrips/greedo/index.html?show=1|text=A Hunter's Fate: Greedo's Tale|int=A Hunter's Fate: Greedo's Tale (webstrip)}}, as part of the rotating display promoting {{SWE|characters|rex|Clone Captain Rex}} was given the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Clone Captain/Legends|clone trooper captain]]. In addition, the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] veterans who trained clone officers on Kamino bestowed on him the battle honor of Mandalorian [[Jaig eyes|''Jaig'' eyes]], and he had the adornments emblazoned on his [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|clone trooper armor's]] [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|helmet]]. In the same year, a new elite [[Legion/Legends|unit]] was formed within the Grand Army: the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], whose members' training surpassed even that of the lethal Advanced Recon [[Commando/Legends|Commandos]].{{StarshipsVehiclesCite|35|Droids, Aliens & Creatures}} Rex was given command of the core group of the 501st Legion, with which he was tasked with patrolling the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy's]] lawless [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].{{DB|character|captainrex|Rex, Clone Captain}}{{DB|organization|five01st|501st Legion}} As part of his designated 501st detachment, Rex received his own [[Troop/Legends|troop]] [[Company/Legends|detail]]—[[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]], which became based out of the [[GAR clone barracks]] on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]'' He and his men were placed under the overall command of Jedi [[General/Legends|General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who accepted his officer's commission after being [[Knighting Ceremony/Legends|appointed]] as a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] four weeks into the war.''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'' As Skywalker's second-in-command, Rex learned much from his [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]],{{SWArchive|url=clonewars/tradingcards/cards/lg_rex.jpg|text=Clone Card: Clone Captain Rex}} developing a certain friendship with him. He operated with Skywalker on the front lines, with the two frequently turning unconventional tactics into Republic victories. As Skywalker later recalled, Rex, as a rookie trooper, was initially eager to follow every order to the letter{{SWE|characters|dogma|Dogma}} but became less wound tight with the passage of [[Time/Legends|time]]. The 501st Legion garnered fame and veteran status under their leadership, and [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] took notice of how Rex and his men adopted Skywalker's unorthodox strategies with repeated success. Under Palpatine's direction, the 501st grew into an amalgamation of clone units whose members underwent secret training and were moved across the galaxy's battlefields as the war effort required.''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' Besides his friendship with Cody, Rex formed a working relationship with [[Denal/Legends|Denal]], a fellow 501st member,''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'' and befriended [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|Advanced Recon Force]] [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Boomer (Advanced Recon Force trooper)|Boomer]].[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes'': Prima Official Game Guide]] He also became acquainted with Cody's own [[High Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. On one assignment, Rex and his [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] teamed up with a squad of elite Advanced Recon Commandos to [[Battle for a strategic city|attack]] a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] army that had captured a strategic [[City/Legends|city]].{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|packtype=Battle Pack|pack=ARC Troopers|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCWBPARCTroopers.asp}} At some point during his service, while equipped with a [[JT-12 jetpack/Legends|JT-12 jetpack]], Rex was along a pathway and encountered an [[A-DSD advanced dwarf spider droid]], which he fired upon from the air. Shortly after the [[Battle of Skye]], Rex and Cody were sent to [[Skye/Legends|the planet]] to collect the remains of the genetic [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] [[Zeta Magnus]], who was seemingly killed by [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Halagad Ventor]]. However, the being slain by Ventor was merely a clone of the real Magnus. Rex and Cody escorted the two vast halves of the fallen terrorist on separate [[Repulsorlift stretcher|grav-stretcher]]s, while other clone troopers loaded the remains of Magnus' lab-instruments and cloning tanks into a Republic [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]]. During the battle, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker, and Ventor were betrayed by [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] of [[Tark Squad]], who turned out to be [[Thyrsian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] working for Magnus. Upon learning that, Rex remarked that Mandalorian-trained soldiers were more trustworthy than those trained by Thyrsians. He also advised Skywalker to start wearing a helmet upon noticing a fresh scar on his face.''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]'' ===Captain of the 501st=== ====Battle of Christophsis==== =====A suspicious ambush===== {{Quote|South tower? We're in the north."
"Not for long. Rex, fire your cables.|Rex and Skywalker prior to assisting Kenobi's ambushed forces|{{TCW|The Hidden Enemy}}}} Seven weeks into the war, Rex and Cody were dispatched with a Republic [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] under the command of Skywalker and Kenobi to [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|liberate]] the planet [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]], which had fallen to the Confederacy and its [[Retail Caucus/Legends|Retail Caucus]] conglomerate. En route to Christophsis aboard a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]], Rex witnessed a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] broadcast alongside Skywalker, Kenobi, and Cody in which General [[Whorm Loathsom/Legends|Whorm Loathsom]], the leader of the enemy invasion, pressured the [[Christophsian/Legends|Christophsian]] populace into submitting to Separatist rule.''[[The Clone Wars: Shadowed]]'' After reaching the [[Christoph system/Legends|Christoph system]], the Republic forces [[Space warfare/Legends|defeated]] Confederate [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Trench/Legends|Trench's]] [[Christophsis blockade/Legends|naval blockade]]{{TCW|Cat and Mouse}} and established a [[Christophsis Republic base/Legends|base]] on the surface. Skywalker and Kenobi then took a clone contingent led by Rex and Cody into the capital, [[Chaleydonia/Legends|Chaleydonia]], more commonly known as Crystal City.''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''''[[Shadow Games]]'' Once there, the Jedi and clones prepared an ambush to offset the Confederacy's advantage in troop strength. They moved into a [[Christophsis double-towered building/Legends|business complex]] with two north- and south-facing towers, from which they intended to intercept a Separatist [[TJ-55's battle droid battalion/Legends|droid battalion]] set to pass through the major plaza below. Rex and Skywalker stationed their men in the north tower's forty-sixth level, while that of the south tower housed the detail led by Kenobi, Cody, and Clone [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Slick/Legends|Slick]]. As the Separatist battalion commanded by the [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] [[TJ-55/Legends|TJ-55]][[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season One|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season One]], "Jedi Temple Archives" Blu-ray feature for "[[The Hidden Enemy]]" marched through the business complex's plaza, the troop column unexpectedly split in half. The Republic's strategy was thus compromised when numerous [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] squads ambushed Kenobi's men in the south tower. After signaling [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] [[Hawk/Legends|Hawk]] for an evacuation, Skywalker, Rex, and their men used their [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifles]]' [[Ascension cable/Legends|ascension cables]] to rappel over to the south tower. They avoided [[Laser/Legends|laser]] fire from the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] below and arrived to reinforce Kenobi and Cody, who were holding out against overwhelming numbers. Once Kenobi temporarily impeded the droids' advance by [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force-pushing]] a [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] at them, the combined clone detachment took a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] to the roof for their evacuation. TJ-55 pursued them to the roof with more droid troops, and Rex, Cody, and the clones provided cover fire for Skywalker and Kenobi to cut through the droids. Hawk's [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]] soon arrived, and Rex and his comrades escaped with TJ-55's cranial unit, which trooper [[Gus/Legends|Gus]] had pilfered.{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode016.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: The Hidden Enemy}} [[File:Christophsis_investigation.png|thumb|right|300px|Rex and Cody examine TJ-55's cranial unit under a robolobotomy following the ambush on Christophsis.]] Back at the base that [[Standard day/Legends|night]], Rex and Cody analyzed TJ-55's cranial unit in the command center under a [[Robolobotomy/Legends|robolobotomy]], but they only confirmed that the Confederacy had been aware of their plan before the unit stopped processing. Upon being apprised of their clone officers' findings, Skywalker suggested that a security breach was the cause for the Separatists' acquisition of their strategy, but Kenobi went so far as to suspect that there was a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] among their men. Skywalker and Kenobi decided to investigate behind enemy lines, ordering Rex and Cody to keep their mission confidential and remain behind to apprehend the potential traitor. =====A spy among the clones===== {{Quote|We've got a big problem"
"Yeah, the only people in here are brothers.|Cody and Rex after pursuing the anonymous spy into the mess hall|}} Shortly after the Jedi departed, Cody was alarmed to find a [[Hush-98 comlink/Legends|Hush-98 comlink]] deliberately left activated on a nearby table with the troops' other equipment, indicating that someone had remotely eavesdropped on their conversation with the Jedi. Rex then noticed a figure in the hallway too far away to be identified: Sergeant Slick, who had become a spy for the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and the Confederacy out of a grudge against the Jedi. Slick immediately broke into a run and ignored Rex's commands to halt, forcing Rex and Cody to pursue him through the base. Despite losing their target, the two officers were able to follow his path through the complex's hallways to the clones' mess hall, where they realized that the traitor was one of their own brethren. Returning to the command center, Rex and Cody attempted to contact Skywalker and Kenobi but found that communications were being blocked, potentially by the spy in their camp. Rex resolved to use Skywalker's [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], to check the station's outgoing transmission logs from the past few days.{{TCW|The Hidden Enemy|d=y}} Musing through R2-D2's findings with a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], Rex traced an odd spike in wavelength interference to a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] terminal located in the [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]] of [[Slick's squad/Legends|Slick's unit]]. Inferring that one of Slick's men was the spy, Rex and Cody decided to individually interrogate the [[Platoon/Legends|platoon's]] members despite protest from Slick. Though troopers [[Jester/Legends|Jester]], [[Punch/Legends|Punch]], [[Sketch/Legends|Sketch]], and Gus all passed interrogation with credible alibis, trooper [[Chopper (clone trooper)/Legends|Chopper]] was forced to reveal that he had broken war protocols by stealing battle droid fingers from the battlefield and stringing them into a [[Necklace/Legends|necklace]]. While attempting to derail Chopper's trustworthiness, Slick inadvertently revealed his knowledge of the Jedi's mission—information he could only have obtained via the open [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] that Cody had found in the command center. When put on the spot, Slick attacked Cody and Chopper and promptly fled from the barracks, leaving his platoon charges, as well as Rex and Cody, shocked with the revelation of the sergeant's true allegiances. =====The traitor exposed===== {{Quote|I think freedom's gonna have to wait, kid.|Rex, while holding Slick under arrest|}} [[File:SlickSurrounded-THE.png|thumb|left|300px|Rex and Cody confront the traitorous Slick in the base's command center.]] Rex and Cody immediately gave chase to the exposed Slick, tracing a signal from his [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]] to the [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] landing platform. Instead of Slick, they found his utility belt attached to a primed [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]], and they scrambled for cover just before the explosive triggered a series of others. The resulting explosion decimated the landing platform and the [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] supply depot, as well as the base's [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]]. Upon learning from Gus and Chopper that Slick had been spotted running into the command center, Rex headed with Cody to apprehend the [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteur]], leaving Slick's platoon and the other troops to seal the perimeter. In the command center, Rex and Cody noticed that Slick was hiding in the above ventilation shaft and engaged in a ploy to bait him out of his hiding place. While Cody secretly removed the ammunition from his [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] and left the weapon on the [[Holotable/Legends|holotable]] console, Rex appeared to leave for the south exit to restart the base's power generators. Once the [[Blast door/Legends|blast doors]] had closed behind him, he reentered the room and assisted Cody in confronting Slick, who had forsook his cover to steal Cody's empty [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. Although held at blasterpoint, Slick refused to surrender, grabbing Rex's DC-15S and bowling him over. In the ensuing brawl, Cody and Slick disarmed each other and engaged in [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]]. When Rex joined in, he received a blow to the head, and Slick knocked him to the floor and used the "[[groin popper]]" maneuver to dislocate his [[Limb/Legends|leg]]. Nevertheless, Cody swiftly [[Sleep/Legends|knocked out]] Slick, and the enemy agent was detained and locked in [[Binders/Legends|handcuffs]]. When Skywalker and Kenobi returned, Rex and Cody presented them with Slick, who, no longer comatose, attempted to justify his actions with his hatred for the Jedi. Slick's accusations elicited rebuttals from his clone officers, who countered that his exploits had endangered the lives of the clone brothers he claimed to love. Once Slick had been ushered away to lockup, Rex and Cody reported the sabotage of the weapons depot to Skywalker and Kenobi, who replied that they had discovered the full strength of the on-world Separatist invasion force, numbering close to a thousand units. =====Battle in the streets===== {{Quote|Not good. They've got an energy shield. That's gonna make things damn near impossible. If you wanted experience, little one, it looks like you're about to get plenty.|Rex, to Ahsoka Tano, during the battle in the city|}} Whorm Loathsom soon launched his first assault on the Republic forces, which became based out of Crystal City. After several days of battle, the Jedi and clones were able to beat back the Separatists, forcing them into retreat for the time being. Rex took advantage of the lapse in fighting to shave his [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and review [[Death/Legends|casualty]] reports on his datapad near the Republic's temporary forward aid station. He conferred and joked there with the [[Clone medic/Legends|medic]] on duty, Clone Sergeant [[Coric]], as well as trooper [[Ged]], who was being treated for a shoulder injury. The moment the Confederate forces initiated another attack, Rex grabbed his [[Blaster rifle/Legends|rifle]] and joined Skywalker and Kenobi in the streets. While Cody assisted Kenobi in marshaling a defense of their base, Rex took a clone platoon to accompany Skywalker along a route parallel to the city's main street. As the clones made their way behind enemy lines, Rex recalled how the antebellum Crystal City had been glittering with beauty just days prior until the fighting crippled the city. He followed Skywalker and the rest of their men, including Coric and a patched-up Ged, to an [[Unidentified energy sphere building|energy sphere tower]], where they divided their troops. While most of the platoon was tasked with targeting the street-level droids, Rex and Skywalker took several troopers to the roof to surprise a trio of advancing [[Octuptarra magna tri-droid/Legends|octuptarra magna tri-droids]]''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]'' from above. Rex and his men used JT-12 jetpacks to reach the street below, while Skywalker landed on one of the tri-droids himself. [[File:Rex_and_Ahsoka.png|thumb|right|300px|Rex and Ahsoka Tano confer on Christophsis, marking the beginning of their strong friendship.]] Rex and his comrades' combined efforts brought down the three droids, and they turned their attention to the droid infantry's exposed rear flank, pressing on without haste. Once Loathsom and his droid army had been driven into another retreat, a Republic [[Unidentified Nu-class attack shuttle (Christophsis)/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttle]] landed in Crystal City's [[City Plaza (Christophsis)|Central Plaza]]. Although Kenobi believed that his new [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] learner was on board, he and Skywalker found that instead of delivering some expected reinforcements, the [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] had brought the young Padawan [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who had been apprenticed not to Kenobi, but to Skywalker. Rex was introduced to Tano at the base's observation post and was surprised to meet the new Padawan, as Skywalker had previously sworn never to take a Padawan. Rex could not help but chuckle when Tano nicknamed her new Master "Skyguy," but Skywalker, annoyed with her hubris and arrogant behavior, told his [[Captain/Legends|captain]] to give her an "acquaint of the position" while taking her on his inspection rounds of Central Plaza's lookout points.''[[The Clone Wars: The New Padawan]]'' Rex complied and ushered Tano away to confer with her privately. Harnessing various elements of his training, Rex helped Tano to better understand her role as a [[Jedi Commander/Legends|commander]] in the Grand Army, and they were able to reach an understanding of each other—although Tano was still eager to prove that she was ready to be Skywalker's apprentice, she learned to be more appropriate and respectful to her superiors. While near the Republic's setup of [[AV-7 Antivehicle Cannon/Legends|AV-7 Antivehicle Cannons]], Tano noticed that the Confederacy was deploying a [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]], a development that alarmed Rex, who knew that such a shield would render the Republic's [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] useless. Both of them joined Skywalker and Kenobi at the [[Comm station/Legends|comm station]] to devise a tactic to repel the imminent Separatist counterattack. =====Unlikely victory===== {{Quote|Sir! General Kenobi's been captured! There's no one else left."
"We've got to hold out! We can't let that shield reach the cannons. Keep fighting!|A clone trooper and Rex while the droid army advances|}} The group decided that Skywalker would take his Padawan behind enemy lines to eliminate the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]], while Rex and Kenobi would engage the droids to stall for time. After Skywalker and Tano departed, Rex and Kenobi attempted to use the heavy [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]] against the enemy's expanding shield but only confirmed that they were indeed useless. Using an unencrypted comlink channel to appear more convincing to the Separatists, Rex ordered the clone forces to fall back before switching back to a secure channel. Via eavesdropping on Confederate voice traffic, he learned that Loathsom had ordered his infantry to target the heavy cannons, which had impeded his troops earlier in the battle but were now ineffectual and vulnerable. As soon as the deflector shield passed over them, Kenobi led a forward charge on Loathsom's front lines, while Rex and his men lured the droids into the buildings along the main street. When the droids fired a [[Missile/Legends|missile]] at the comm post that Rex was using as cover, the explosion winded him and knocked him to the ground. After being forced to pull back his men, he met with Kenobi at the command center. Although Rex proposed that they use the heavy cannons in spite of the shield, which would cause fatal overpressure and result in severe collateral damage, Kenobi instead ordered him to mobilize a defense of the cannons while the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] delayed the droids. Despite his reluctance to leave Kenobi to fend for himself, Rex obeyed orders and retreated while Kenobi confronted the oncoming droids. As the shield approached the heavy cannons, Rex, Coric, and their men countered the advancing droids' fire from some rubble near the main street. Rex soon learned that Kenobi had surrendered to Loathsom, but he deduced that the Jedi General was simply stalling and rallied his men to hold the line. [[File:Got_to_hold_out.png|thumb|left|300px|Facing overwhelming odds in Crystal City, Rex rallies his troops to hold the line.]] As Rex and his men withstood the onslaught from the droids' overwhelming numbers, Skywalker and Tano eliminated the shield generator. Rex was aiming at a [[Unidentified Kerkoiden commander|Kerkoiden tank commander]] when he caught a glimpse of the receding shield, and he killed the enemy officer out of sheer relief at the sight. He quickly ordered the heavy cannons to commence firing on the exposed Separatists and their [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]], to great effect. With Republic Admiral [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] and Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] arriving with reinforcements to complete the process of securing Christophsis, Rex allowed himself to breathe and personally feel the deaths of his men, acknowledging the pain that came with losing them. Although LAAT/i gunships flew in and began to bombard the nearby droid lines, he braved the incoming fire to help Coric search through the debris for two surviving troopers whom they had located via their helmets' [[Heads-up display/Legends|heads-up displays]]. Rex later took a gunship to pick up Skywalker and Tano from the shield generator site, then returned with them to the command base in Crystal City. During the flight back, he congratulated Skywalker and Tano on their successful mission—making a point to commend the young Tano, who was slowly earning his respect. ====Battle of Teth==== {{Quote|If we can't stop them, then we delay them as long as we can, and after that we make sure they have to crawl over our bodies. It's been an honor, gentlemen.|Rex, to Torrent Company|}} Following the victory on Christophsis, Skywalker and Tano were assigned to rescue [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]], the son of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], from enemy kidnappers. Their orders came as part of the Republic's overall effort to convince Jabba to grant the Grand Army access to [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace lanes]] running through [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt-controlled space]]. Rex and Torrent Company accompanied the two Jedi to the planet [[Teth/Legends|Teth]]—where Republic Advanced Recon Force trooper [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] had tracked the Huttlet—in an [[Anakin Skywalker's Acclamator-class assault ship (Teth)/Legends|''Acclamator''-class transport]]. Because the clifftop [[B'omarr Monastery|monastery]] where Rotta was being held was a half-mile off the ground and was being guarded by a detachment of battle droids, Skywalker elected to launch a [[Battle of Teth/Legends|vertical assault]] up the cliff face to reach the monastery. LAAT/i gunships ferried Torrent Company to the surface, and [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/carrier/Legends|LAAT carriers]] brought a pair of [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE walkers]] along as extra support. When the monastery's droid defenders opened fire on the approaching craft, [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|Clone Lieutenant]] Hawk—the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the gunship carrying Skywalker, Tano, Rex, and their men—closed the gunship's [[Blast shield (gunship)/Legends|blast shields]] to deflect the incoming fire. The gunships landed in the forest below the cliff, and the AT-TEs returned fire at the droids, providing cover for the Jedi and clones to take refuge in an overhang. [[File:Attecliff.png|thumb|right|300px|Rex scales the cliff with Torrent Company, with the final AT-TE following behind him.]] Rex soon sighted an object falling from the cliff, and what he initially believed was an explosive device turned out to be a [[Unidentified B1 battle droid sergeant (Teth)/Legends|fallen battle droid]]. Following Skywalker and Tano's lead, the men of Torrent Company employed their blasters' ascension cables to scale the cliff, with Rex using his [[rappel line]] to ascend it. As a vertical [[Lightfight|crossfire]] commenced, the droid cannonades felled one of the AT-TE [[Walker/Legends|walkers]], severing its grip on the cliff. Rex watched in horror as the AT-TE plummeted to the ground, taking all of the troops beneath along with it. When B1 battle droids on [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]] flew in to attack the clones in mid-climb, Rex trained his blasterfire at the airborne droids before Skywalker eliminated them. Torrent Company reached the monastery and destroyed the remainder of the droid infantry, albeit at the loss of half of its men. Upon arrival at the summit, Rex called in a gunship to casevac their fifteen wounded troopers, assigning several men to look after them in the meantime. He and Skywalker deduced from the heavy droid presence that the Separatists were the Huttlet's captors. Leaving most of the men outside in the event of another assault,[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (junior novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' junior novelization]] Rex took Sergeant Coric and troopers [[Lunn]], [[Vaize]], and [[Ayar]] to help Skywalker and Tano scour the monastery for the missing Huttlet. Entering the dimly lit castle, Rex and his men activated their helmet's headlights for better vision. Inside, the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[4A-7/Legends|4A-7]], claiming to be the monastery's caretaker, greeted and thanked them for liberating him from the battle droids. Learning from the protocol droid that the Separatists had kept their [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] on the detention level, Skywalker and Tano proceeded there to rescue the Huttlet while Rex and his men stayed behind to guard the entrance. Though unable to confirm his suspicions, Rex correctly suspected that 4A-7 was not what he appeared to be—the droid was aiding the Dark Acolyte Asajj Ventress as part of a Separatist plot to frame the Republic and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for Rotta's kidnapping. Rex returned to the monastery courtyard and finished securing the castle with his troops. As midday approached, he learned from Skywalker that Rotta had been found and sent Coric to help transport the Huttlet with a [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]]. Upon their return, Skywalker and Tano prepared to leave Teth with Rotta aboard a gunship that Rex had on standby for them. However, Tano's discovery that the Huttlet was ill halted their preparations for an evacuation and forced them to consider another solution. While Skywalker and Tano were delivering a status report to Kenobi through R2-D2's [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] link, a pair of Confederate [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] approached the monastery and deployed [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]] and ground troops. With battle droids invading the courtyard, Rex and Skywalker mobilized Torrent Company to defend their position while Tano returned inside with Rotta. After briefly conferring with Skywalker on the weak chances of getting Tano and Rotta safely off-planet, Rex dispatched Sergeants Coric and [[Hez]] and their squads to provide covering fire for the rest of the company. Their remaining AT-TE walker was shot down, and Torrent Company began to take heavy losses. Rex joined his men in retreating into the monastery, and with everyone else inside, Skywalker ordered his captain to shut the entrance door. He initially refused, as Skywalker would be locked outside with the droids, but when his general tersely repeated the order, he complied and fired a blaster round at the controls. Skywalker used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to propel himself through the closing gap and into the entrance chamber, sealing all of them inside. With three-quarters of their men dead, several wounded, and only three [[Medic/Legends|medic]]-trained troopers remaining, Tano convinced her Master that it was best to find medical attention for the sick Rotta. Skywalker and his Padawan left with R2-D2 to escape from the castle while Rex remained with Torrent Company to hold their position. [[File:Rex_shoots_at_Ventress.png|thumb|left|300px|Rex "returns" from a feigned death and trains his fire on Asajj Ventress.]] Rex and his men braced themselves as the Separatist battalion—under the command of Asajj Ventress—disabled the door's lock mechanism, allowing B1, [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2]], and [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droids]] to flood into the stronghold in overwhelming numbers. Rex watched as his men fell to enemy fire one by one before being knocked to the ground himself. Feigning death, he secretly contacted his surviving comrades through their private comm frequency and learned that only five of his men, including Coric, remained. As Ventress entered the antechamber and gave orders to an [[Unidentified OOM command battle droid 2 (Teth)/Legends|OOM command battle droid]], Rex destroyed the [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|droid]] with one of his [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blasters]] and then targeted the Dark Acolyte. However, Ventress immediately drew her [[Asajj Ventress's lightsabers/Legends|double-bladed lightsabers]] and deflected his laser shots. She telekinetically disarmed him of his [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and Force-choked him, demanding that he reveal Skywalker's whereabouts. Having been trained in mental resistance, Rex kept repeating his name, rank, trooper designation, and battle group to avoid succumbing to her influence. She finally gave up her interrogation and, after dropping the defiant Rex to the floor, performed a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]], ordering him to contact Skywalker and ask for his general's location. Rex resisted Ventress's influence and commed Skywalker of his own accord, using a false voice and addressing him as "Anakin" instead of his usual "General Skywalker" to allude to Ventress's presence.''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'' suggests that Rex was unable to resist the [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] that [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] performed on him, but the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|novelization]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] maintains that he was indeed able to avoid succumbing to her mind influence. This article assumes that the latter's interpretation is correct. Unaware of his exploit, Ventress threw him aside and departed to personally confront Skywalker, tasking her battle droids with guarding the survivors of Torrent Company. Though he suspected that his [[Rib/Legends|ribs]] had been broken, Rex mimicked unconsciousness to avoid attracting the droids' attention. He repeatedly checked in with his men over their private frequency, keeping them prepared to mount a last stand. Skywalker soon made contact via comlink, and because Rex had forgotten to divert the signal to his helmet, the battle droids overheard the device. As the enemy units converged on him, he destroyed several of the droids closest to him and stole an [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifle]] from one of them. Moving as one, the other 501st survivors—Coric, [[Nax/Legends|Nax]], [[Zeer (clone trooper)|Zeer]], [[Del (clone trooper)|Del]], and [[Attie]]—sprang to their feet and also attacked their captors, pilfering blasters for themselves. Using the fallen AT-TE as cover, they engaged the droids in a crossfire. Rex took a [[Painkiller/Legends|painkiller]] from his utility belt [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]] before reporting their situation to Skywalker. Eventually, Zeer planted explosives in an eviscerated super battle droid and detonated the unit once it had been sent back into the Confederate lines. The trap droid destroyed many of its comrades, but only a few [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] elapsed before the droids regrouped to resume their attack. Rex and his comrades were able to bring down an advancing Vulture [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighter]], using it as cover to combat the droids at a closer proximity. Nevertheless, the clone troopers were seriously outnumbered, and the battle droids demanded their surrender. At that moment, Obi-Wan Kenobi arrived at Teth with [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] Cody, the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]], and an armada under the command of Wullf Yularen. Leading an aerial assault on the droids, Kenobi jumped out of his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B starfighter]] to assist Rex and the other Torrent Company survivors while LAAT/i gunships deployed Cody and his men. Learning from Rex that Skywalker was most likely still in the stronghold, Kenobi left to find his fellow Jedi General. Eventually, Skywalker—having found and commandeered the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']], an old [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[G9 Rigger-class light freighter/Legends|freighter]], with Tano and Rotta—contacted Rex, reluctantly telling him that they would be unable to give support since returning Rotta to his [[Parent/Legends|father]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] was still their priority. Rex understood his general's dilemma and replied that he and his men would be able to hold out thanks to Kenobi's aid. Under covering fire from his men, Rex charged at an advancing dwarf spider droid and planted a primed thermal detonator on it, jumping away in time to avoid the explosion that engulfed it. [[File:RexTethSurrounded.png|thumb|right|300px|Though outnumbered, Rex and his men mount a final stand on Teth just prior to Obi-Wan Kenobi's arrival.]] As Rex and his men cut through the battle droids, Kenobi returned from a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] with Ventress. Rex voiced his doubt that Skywalker and Tano would be able to reach Tatooine in their dilapidated [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], but Kenobi was confident that Skywalker's expertise at a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] controls would prove adequate. After the Republic finally emerged victorious on Teth, Rex conferred with Cody amidst the settling dust, venting his frustration with the poorly handled operation. Although Rex was still devastated with the loss of Torrent Company, his friend stated that their efforts had not been in vain, as Skywalker and Tano had reached Tatooine with Rotta. The two clone officers accompanied Masters Yoda and Kenobi to [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] on Tatooine to retrieve Skywalker and Tano, who had [[Mission to Jabba's Palace (Clone Wars)/Legends|returned]] Rotta to his father and established a [[Hutt–Republic treaty/Legends|treaty]] with the Hutts for Grand Army access through Hutt [[Realspace/Legends|Space]]. Upon meeting with Rex, Skywalker and Tano wanted to hear all the details of the battle's end, of the men who had won and paid the ultimate price for the victory. Despite his distress, Rex agreed to recount it to them. Though Torrent Company was replenished with new troops, the defeat of the original unit stayed with Rex for a long time.''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]'' ====Trooper's mission==== The clone soldier [[Trooper (clone trooper)|Trooper]] served under Rex. At some point during the Clone Wars, Obi-Wan Kenobi sent Trooper to defend a Republic stronghold holding [[Jedi artifact/Legends|Jedi artifacts]], to prevent a Separatist attack. Trooper abandoned his post, reached the command center's perimeter, and fought through B1 and B2 battle droids to reach it. At the command center, Captain Rex told Trooper that the droid army had found a weakness in the facility's shields and had breached part of the base. Although the situation was under control, Rex warned that battle droids were still active between Trooper and the extraction point. As Trooper moved through the base, they encountered the droids Rex had mentioned. Trooper made their way to the rendezvous, joining with Rex and his platoon, and the clones boarded a transport to head for the Republic stronghold. Aboard the transport, Trooper provided cover fire to help Rex's platoon land at the droid-held stronghold. After the firefight, Rex sent Trooper to a [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] position to defend while Rex and his troops secured the inside of the base. After they secured the base, Anakin Skywalker arrived at the stronghold, Trooper escorted him to the front lines. Rex, after reaching the front lines, regrouped the Republic troops and prepared them for a full-scale assault on the droid forces. He gave Trooper another mission, to return to the defense outpost and destroy the Separatist Armored Assault Tank en route, which they accomplished.''[[Clone Trooper Blaster Game]]'' ====Shipyards of Gwori==== {{Quote|Still no word. We have to assume they're in trouble. I think it's time to alter Master Skywalker's orders.''"
"''Are you sure, sir?''"
"''Rex, just like Master Skywalker, you ''will'' have to learn to trust me.|Ahsoka Tano and Rex, on their orders to stay put during the infiltration of Gwori|''[[The Clone Wars: Shipyards of Doom]]''}} As warfare continued to devastate the galaxy, the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]], outnumbering the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] fourfold, put the Republic's war effort at a supreme disadvantage. With the likelihood of being prematurely defeated in the war, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] decided to impair Separatist starship production by targeting the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan's]] Confederate-allied [[Gwori shipyards]]. Because the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards']] exact location on [[Gwori]]'s planetary surface had yet to be determined, the task of pinpointing it fell to Rex, Skywalker, and Kenobi. To penetrate Gwori's defenses—namely, a droid-operated [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] and a [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] beam that eradicated all life forms bound for the planet—Skywalker chalked out a plan for a small strike force to be temporarily [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|frozen]] in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]. R2-D2, whose presence would not cause much suspicion to the blockade's droid security, would then pilot the team to Gwori. After locating the shipyards, they would relay the coordinates to Generals [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]], who would eliminate the facility with a Republic [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]]. Initiating preparations on Coruscant, Rex gathered a clone squad at carbonite freezing plant [[CT-642]], where Skywalker assured his captain that they would not be frozen long enough for [[Hibernation sickness/Legends|hibernation sickness]] to take effect. Rex and his men, along with Skywalker and Kenobi, were encased in carbonite with the addition of Tano, who had been ordered not to participate in the mission but nonetheless manipulated Admiral Yularen to grant her clearance. Rex and the strike team [[Battle of Gwori|proceeded]] to Gwori aboard the freighter [[VX-391]], with R2-D2 at the controls. When the blockade's battle droids discovered that the ship was unregistered, R2-D2 was forced to release the task force and jettison from the vessel just before the battle droids shot down the freighter. The [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] freed Tano from her carbonite slab, and she in turn released Rex and the others. Once they had found the enemy facility, Skywalker and Kenobi sent Rex, Tano, R2-D2, and two [[Unidentified clone trooper (Gwori)|other]] clone troopers to contact Koon and Tiin from a nearby [[Station 22|communication tower]]. After the group broke into the station, Tano transmitted the shipyards' coordinates to Koon, Tiin, and Yularen, who were waiting in the [[Moskk system/Legends|Moskk system]]. Before Rex and his comrades could arrange to be evacuated from Gwori, the transmission was cut off when the shipyards' supervisor, [[Overseer/Legends|Overseer]] [[Juhm]], contacted the station and discovered the presence of the Republic strike team. Rex, Tano, and their men managed to flee with R2-D2 just before Juhm remotely destroyed the station, and Tano relayed the developments to Skywalker and Kenobi. While their superiors infiltrated the shipyards, Rex, Tano, and their team went to find cover on Gwori's plains, where a squad of [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]]-equipped [[B2-RP battle droid/Legends|B2-RP battle droids]]''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]'' attacked them. [[File:RexAhsokaOnGwori-SOD.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Rex and Ahsoka Tano decide to comply with Overseer Juhm's demands.]] After escaping from the droids, Rex and his comrades took refuge in a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] that they soon found was the current residence of a large [[Unidentified Gwori lizard|lizard-like creature]], which killed one of the clones before Tano could eliminate it. As time passed, the extended lack of communication from Skywalker and Kenobi led Tano to conclude that their [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] were in trouble. She decided that it was time to "alter" Skywalker's orders of staying concealed, and though Rex voiced some doubt, he left the cave with Tano and the other trooper. However, Juhm was waiting for them just outside with a squad of B2 super battle droids and killed their clone companion on sight. Presented with the choice of capitulating or being immediately gunned down, Rex and Tano decided to comply with Juhm's demands and were taken away, leaving R2-D2 back in the cave. As night fell, Juhm had Rex and Tano attached to electrically charged frames alongside Skywalker and Kenobi, who had been captured at the shipyards. Before departing, Juhm left a trio of [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]] to guard them from a horde of local [[Spider/Legends|spiders]], his intent being to let them survive as a reminder to the shipyards' [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] of his absolute superiority. Although the four were [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] and electrocuted in turn, Rex grudgingly expressed his gratitude for the MagnaGuards' protection from the spiders. In an attempt to free themselves, Skywalker, Tano, and Kenobi used the Force to destroy the MagnaGuards, and R2-D2 arrived and cut them and Rex from their frames before the spiders could attack. The team proceeded to the shipyards and convinced Juhm's slaves, who numbered over a thousand, to emancipate themselves from their servitude. At dawn the next day, Rex, Skywalker, Tano, and Kenobi stole [[Unidentified Munificent-class star frigate (Gwori)|one]] of the shipyards' near-completed [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]] and escaped aboard it with the ex-slaves, just as Koon and Tiin arrived with their team of [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]]. Koon and Tiin led the [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]] of [[Hunter Squadron (Galactic Republic)|Hunter Squadron]] on their strike on the Banking Clan facility, dropping their munitions on the site. Skywalker, meanwhile, used their [[Frigate/Legends|frigate's]] [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] to retrieve trooper [[Toomer]], who had been left behind at the drop zone when his carbonite slab's controls malfunctioned, and headed for the Separatist blockade. However, the battle droids overseeing the blockade detected the multitude of life forms aboard the stolen frigate, and at Juhm's behest, they activated the radiation beam. Before the beam could vaporize Rex and the other passengers, Koon and Tiin intervened, disabling the scan gate that was projecting the beam. The two Jedi Masters hitched a ride on the vessel, as their [[Hyperspace transport ring/Legends|hyperdrive booster rings]] had been destroyed, and they left the [[Gwori system/Legends|Gwori system]] for Coruscant, where Juhm's ex-slaves found employment with the Republic. Once Toomer had been freed from his carbonite, Rex reassured the disappointed trooper that there would be more fighting to come. ====Outpost inspections==== =====New assignments===== {{Quote|Alright, this is a ''Code Aurek'' alert. I want every one of you to search every nook, every cranny, for a place this rodent could be hiding.|Rex|''[[The Clone Wars: Mouse Hunt]]''}} Rex was stationed with Skywalker, Tano, and Admiral Yularen aboard{{TCW|Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence''}} {{C|Director's Cut extended version included in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season One|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season One]] DVD collection}} Skywalker's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the ''Venator''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']],{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode002.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Rising ''Malevolence''}} when it was deployed to the [[Bith system/Legends|Bith system]] during the emerging threat of a new Separatist [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]. After the enemy weapon executed a [[Battle of Abregado/Legends|devastating assault]] on Plo Koon's forces in the nearby [[Abregado system/Legends|Abregado system]], the ''Resolute'' was reassigned to protect the Republic's supply [[Convoy/Legends|convoys]] alongside Kenobi; his flagship, the [[Negotiator/Legends|''Negotiator'']]; and the rest of their [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. Skywalker thereafter divided his armada to increase their defensive perimeter and departed with Tano to scout ahead for enemy activity. Rex was present on the ''Resolute''{{'s}} [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] with Yularen when Kenobi contacted them to check on their progress as well as Skywalker's whereabouts. Yularen reported that the convoys were on schedule and also informed Kenobi of Skywalker's orders. Skywalker and Tano soon discovered that the Separatist superweapon was the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], a powerful [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] that was equipped with an [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|ion pulse cannon]]. Rex later reviewed the file on the Abregado incident, hoping that it would give him an edge in future battles against the Separatists.{{TCW|Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence''|d=y}} The ''Resolute'' was again reassigned, this time to join a Republic [[Navy/Legends|naval]] strike on the ''Malevolence'' near the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]].{{TCW|Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence''}} The ensuing [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]] saw the [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]] eradicated, its threat to the Republic ended.{{TCW|Destroy Malevolence|Destroy ''Malevolence''}} [[File:RexCodeAurek-TCWMouseHunt.png|thumb|right|150px|Rex issues a Code Aurek alert at the Pastil station.]] Rex and Commander Cody were next assigned to inspect several small but integral Republic bases and [[Listening post/Legends|listening posts]].{{StarshipsVehiclesCite|32|Welcome On Board}} Their first inspection site was a [[Pastil tracking station/Legends|tracking station]] in the [[Pastil system/Legends|Pastil system]]. Upon arrival on [[Pastil/Legends|Pastil]] aboard Rex's ''Nu''-class attack [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], the [[Obex/Legends|''Obex'']], Rex began assessing the outpost with Cody and commented on the station's extreme cleanliness. Trooper [[Stripe]] informed them that an [[MSE-series]] droid nicknamed "[[Rodent/Legends|Rodent]]" maintained the base, mentioning that the droid had a glitch and spent [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] cleaning the outpost. Recognizing the droid's characteristics as those of a [[Espionage droid|spy droid]], Rex called out a [[Code Aurek]] alert and [[Skirmish on Pastil|ordered]] the facility's troopers to track down Rodent. The rookie clones were unaware of Rex's suspicions and initially thought he was crazy, but when Rex found the droid and blasted its body, the droid's [[wheel]]s activated of their own accord and fled, a feature uncommon in regular MSE droids. The troopers eliminated three of the wheels, and when the fourth made for a grate, Stripe destroyed it with a thermal detonator; the resulting explosion caused a significant amount of damage to the hallway. Amused with Stripe's solution, Rex told the troops to clean up the mess before leaving the station with Cody. =====Rishi station===== {{Quote|All right, listen up. There's only one target of interest in this sector: Kamino. It's the closest thing we clones have to a home. Today we fight for more than the Republic. Today, we fight for all our brothers back home. Understood?''"
"''Sir, yes, sir!|Rex, to Echo, Fives, and Hevy|audio=RexPepTalk-Rookies.flac|}} After Cody reported their successful inspection to Skywalker and Kenobi, who were aboard the ''Resolute'',{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode005.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Rookies}} he and Rex proceeded to [[Rishi Station/Legends|Rishi Station]], an outpost in the Outer Rim's [[Rishi system/Legends|Rishi system]]. They were unaware that Confederate [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] had just [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|overrun]] the base. When Cody contacted Rishi Station for landing authorization, a droid commando posing as a clone trooper answered the transmission. Hearing the trooper's droid-like responses, Rex sensed that something was amiss but continued with Cody to the [[Rishi moon|moon]] where the outpost was located, with Cody placing him in charge of the inspection. Upon landing at the station, Rex noted the absence of an on-duty [[Deck officer/Legends|deck officer]], remarking that such an error was sloppy. A droid commando disguised in clone [[Armor/Legends|armor]] came out to greet Rex and Cody. When Rex caught sight of a [[Droid attack flare/Legends|droid attack flare]] launched from close by, he promptly shot the "trooper" who had greeted them in the head. At first, Cody was shocked with his brazen behavior, but Rex removed his victim's helmet to unmask the disabled droid. [[File:Watching_Rishi_Station_die.png|thumb|left|300px|Rex and the other clones look at Rishi station.]] More droid commandos appeared and ambushed Rex and Cody, who exchanged fire with them while using some of the surrounding crates as cover. The droids tossed a series of thermal detonators at the ''Obex'', forcing the two officers to jump off the landing platform. They fired their blaster cables at the underside of the platform and rappelled to the ground below; the droids, meanwhile, presumed that the explosion had claimed their lives. With the ''Obex'' destroyed, Rex and Cody mused over being stranded on the [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]], recalling their similar situation on Tibrin. They came across the three survivors of the droid assault—[[Hevy/Legends|Hevy]], [[Fives/Legends|Fives]], and [[Echo/Legends|Echo]], who had also launched the warning [[Flare/Legends|flare]]—and Rex ordered them to take off their helmets to verify that they were clones. After the three did so, a predatory [[Rishi eel/Legends|Rishi eel]] emerged from a nearby crevice; Rex impressed the three rookie troopers by expertly killing the [[Eel/Legends|eel]] with a single blaster shot to its eye. Once they introduced themselves, Rex and Cody learned from Echo that their [[O'Niner/Legends|sergeant]] had died in the initial attack. Dubbing Echo, Hevy, and Fives "[[Shiny/Legends|shinies]]," a derogatory term for their as-yet-unspoiled armor, Rex placed a handprint of [[Blood/Legends|blood]] from the eel's carcass on Echo's armor to commemorate his valor.{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|pack=(Wal-Mart Exclusive) Captain Rex & Clone Trooper Fives|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCWexRookies2.asp}} When Hevy expressed the rookies' shared desire to recover their outpost regardless of their inexperience, Rex stated that there was hope for them yet. The five troopers climbed up the canyon wall to Rishi Station, with Rex and Cody offering the [[Blaster carbine/Legends|carbines]] of their DC-15S blasters to the rookie troopers. Rex devised a plan to gain access to the enemy-held base, posing as Commando [[Unit 26/Legends|Unit 26]] in clone armor and mechanically walking toward the blast doors' [[TT-8L gatekeeper droid/Legends|surveillance systems]]. He conferred with Droid [[07/Legends|Units 07]], [[08/Legends|08]], and [[09/Legends|09]], who were guarding the entrance from inside. He maintained his cover by pretending to adjust his "[[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]]" and using an inert droid head as visual verification of his identity. Although Cody doubted the tactic would work, the droids admitted Rex entry, and he and the others gunned down the guards with celerity. Taking point despite Hevy's request for the lead position, Rex led the assault on the droids in the command center. He gunned down several of the droid commandos manning the central computer before the [[Sparky/Legends|droid commando captain]] targeted him from atop a perch on a higher level. Rex blasted the droid's blaster out of his hand, which only caused his opponent to draw a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]], but he quickly snapped the droid's neck with his [[Glove/Legends|gloved]] hands. [[File:Rex_inspirational.png|thumb|right|300px|Rex and Cody prepare Echo, Fives, and Hevy for the coming battle on the Rishi moon.]] Though Rex and the others triumphed over the droid commandos, their victory was short-lived. The group of five discovered that a Separatist fleet—led by General [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]—was passing over the moon, and they deduced that the droids had hot-wired the station's all-clear signal to prevent the Republic from learning of the impending invasion. To investigate the lack of response from the droid commandos, Grievous dispatched a C-9979 troopship, which landed at the base and deployed droid infantry reinforcements. As Cody noted their slim chances of success, Rex decided that they had to destroy Rishi Station: Despite the plan's lack of convention, the subsequent cessation of the all-clear signal would alert the Republic to the invasion. Echo contributed to Rex's plan, offering that they could repurpose the station's supply of liquid [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna gas]] as explosives to raze the facility. Before setting the operation into motion, Rex and Cody spoke with Echo, Fives, and Hevy to prepare them for the forthcoming battle. Rex stated that the Confederacy's main target could only be Kamino and cited its personal importance to the clones, rallying the rookie troopers with the knowledge that they were fighting for all of their brethren back [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] on Kamino. [[File:Plunkplunk.png|thumb|left|220px|Rex ushers a plunk droid into the command center.]] While Cody, Hevy, and Fives confronted the battle droids at the entrance, Rex and Echo ushered several [[PLNK-series power droid/Legends|PLNK-series power droids]], or "plunk droids,"''[[Scavenger's Guide to Droids]]'' containing the liquid Tibanna into the command center. As they wired the three plunk droids together, Rex encountered problems with the detonator's remote handset. Hevy offered to stay and repair the remote, allowing Rex, Cody, Echo, and Fives to escape outside via a maintenance pipe. Rex assumed that Hevy had summarily fixed the remote and was right behind them, but when he told Hevy to detonate the explosives, he discovered that the trooper had not yet joined them. He contacted Hevy and ordered him to vacate the base, but Hevy stated that he would have to manually activate the charges due to the remote's defectiveness, ignoring Rex's protests. Although Rex and the others backtracked to help their comrade, Hevy [[Death/Legends|sacrificed himself]] to destroy the base and warn the Republic of the Separatist invasion. The termination of the all-clear signal elicited an immediate reaction from the Republic fleet, which arrived and drove Grievous's invasion force out of the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. LAAT/i gunships collected Rex, Cody, Fives, and Echo from the moon and brought them aboard the ''Resolute''. In the Star Destroyer's [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], Skywalker and Kenobi commended Echo and Fives for their valor, awarding them medals, and also honored Hevy's sacrifice. Rex, impressed by the efforts of the former "shinies," inducted Fives and Echo into the 501st Legion. ====Redeployment==== {{Quote|Your troops are settled, Captain? And ready for the fray?''"
"''Yes, sir. They've adjusted well, and will do you proud.|Anakin Skywalker and Rex, upon the latter's arrival on the ''Resolute''|}} [[File:ReportFromFalleen-DOAD.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Anakin Skywalker, Ahsoka Tano, and Rex learn of the Republic's defeat at Falleen from Obi-Wan Kenobi.]] Rex and Skywalker soon returned to Coruscant,{{SW|url=news/chronicling-the-clone-wars-3|text=Chronicling ''The Clone Wars'' #3|int=Chronicling The Clone Wars}} where Rex manned a blaster training range to maintain his troops' marksmanship skills.{{TCWA|loc=Training Room}} Just over a week after their return, word reached the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] that General Grievous was targeting the planet [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], home to the key Republic-affiliated [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]]. Skywalker was subsequently given command of his own battle group to defend the strategic world from the Confederacy. Kenobi, who was out of action due to being injured in a recent [[Coruscant Administrative Sector terrorist attack|terrorist bombing]], had Rex and the 501st Legion put on standby, knowing that Skywalker would want them for his strike force. After receiving his orders, Rex got his men settled on the ''Resolute'', which was being prepared for Skywalker's fleet along with two other ''Venator''-class Star Destroyers, the ''[[Pioneer]]'' and [[Dauntless (Venator-class)|''Dauntless'']]. He enjoyed a brief reunion with Skywalker and Tano, who were pleased that he had been assigned to their task force. Once all was ready, they set off for the [[Both system]], with Grievous and an armada of four ''Munificent''-class star frigates pursuing them there. Although they beat Grievous to Bothawui, Rex, Skywalker, and Tano learned from Kenobi that Grievous had not abandoned his pursuit of them. As Kenobi told them, Grievous was still on course to the Both system, having merely stopped to take on two additional frigates, which he had used to [[Fall of Falleen|overwhelm]] Republic forces on the planet [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]]. Despite being outnumbered two-to-one in vessels, Skywalker was intent on protecting Bothawui and was unwilling to let it fall to the Confederacy. He deployed a detachment of AT-TE walkers under Rex's command to the [[Golm asteroid belt|asteroid belt]] surrounding{{TCW|Downfall of a Droid}} the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Golm|Bothawui Prime]],''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' from where they would be able to outflank Grievous once his fleet passed through the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]]. After Grievous's frigates arrived in the system, proceeded through the [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]]—as well as the AT-TEs hidden there—and opened fire on the Republic Star Destroyers, Rex and his men turned the tide of the [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|battle]] by attacking the frigates, targeting their aft sections. The ambush was all the more successful because the unsuspecting Grievous had diverted all of his frigates' power to their forward shields instead of their rear ones. The ''Resolute'', ''Pioneer'', and ''Dauntless'' annihilated the trapped Separatist armada but not before Grievous could flee from his [[Grievous's frigate/Legends|command ship]]. Skywalker's [[Anakin Skywalker's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B starfighter]] took on damage while pursuing Grievous's personal [[Belbullab-22 starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], [[Soulless One/Legends|''Soulless One'']], and veered off-course toward the asteroid belt. Rex led a search-and-rescue mission into the asteroid belt;{{TCW|Downfall of a Droid|d=y}} he managed to save Skywalker from his crippled [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] but could not retrieve R2-D2, who had served as the Jedi General's astromech co-pilot. Rex and Tano met with Skywalker in the ''Resolute''{{'s}} [[Medical bay/Legends|medbay]] once he had regained consciousness and brought him up to date with the battle's success, albeit with the loss of R2-D2. After conducting an [[Ambush on the Vulture's Claw/Legends|unsuccessful search]] for his astromech droid, Skywalker was forced to declare R2-D2 missing in action. Believing that the ''Resolute'', ''Dauntless'', and ''Pioneer'' could use modifications, Skywalker took his fleet back to the [[Allanteen VI shipyards/Legends|Allanteen Six shipyards]], where they had been manufactured. Eventually, Kenobi contacted Skywalker and Tano and tasked them with finding a new Confederate listening post that was intercepting Grand Army transmissions. Departing from the shipyards on his new assignment, Skywalker elected to personally reconnoiter space suspected of Confederate activity{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode006.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Downfall of a Droid}} while the rest of his forces concentrated on a more central path. Upon being informed of Skywalker's reconnaissance plan, Rex questioned whether he was sure about scouting ahead alone, but Skywalker was certain that more than one fighter would attract too much enemy attention. [[File:Rex_pointing.png|thumb|left|300px|Rex insists he will never carry an astromech again after hauling R3-S6 to Skytop Station.]] Skywalker brought along the replacement [[R3-series astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R3-S6/Legends|R3-S6]] and [[Mission to suspected Confederate space/Legends|departed]] from the ''Resolute'' in his retrieved [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B starfighter]], unaware that R3-S6 was a spy working for Grievous.{{TCW|Duel of the Droids}} Not long after Skywalker left, Tano received a signal from the [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] of her Master's interceptor—his covert position had been compromised. Rex quickly gathered a squad of troopers to accompany Tano aboard the ''Twilight'', and they arrived to reinforce Skywalker, whom Grievous was cornering with two ''Munificent''-class frigates and a squadron of Vulture droids. Because enemy fire had ruptured his [[Syliure-31 hyperspace docking ring/Legends|hyperspace docking ring]], Skywalker piloted his starfighter into the ''Twilight''{{'s}} cargo bay to retreat aboard the freighter. With Rex and his men providing covering fire as [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]], Tano maneuvered the ''Twilight'' right between the adjacent wings of the enemy frigates. As soon as they were clear, Rex engaged the ''Twilight''{{'s}} [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], executing a successful escape. A short while later, R2-D2, whom the [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] [[Gha Nachkt/Legends|Gha Nachkt]] had captured, was able to get a message through to the ''Twilight''. Rex tracked the transmission's origin to [[Ruusan 2/Legends|Ruusan 2]], a moon of the planet [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]], where they proceeded to investigate the source. Within the upper [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of Ruusan 2, Rex and his comrades found [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]], the Separatist listening post that they were after, and they concluded from R2-D2's message that the astromech droid was aboard the [[Space station/Legends|station]]. Despite orders from Kenobi to focus on sabotaging the enemy outpost, Skywalker resolved to mount a [[Raid on Skytop Station/Legends|dual operation]] to destroy the base and save R2-D2. Once the ''Twilight'' entered the gassy atmosphere of the moon, Skywalker, Tano, Rex, and four other troopers used the Force and JT-12 jetpacks, respectively, to safely land on the station many [[Meter/Legends|meters]] below. Rex carried R3-S6 to the station at Tano's behest, a job he was not enthusiastic about undertaking because of the astromech's substantial weight. Upon landing with the heavy R3-S6 in his arms, he insisted that he would never lug around an astromech droid again. Rex entered the station with the squad and joined another trooper in shooting down two B1 battle droid guards in their path. At a nearby computer terminal, R3-S6 accessed the building schematics of the [[Battlesphere/Legends|battlesphere]], which Rex used to brief their team on the location of the station's [[Reactor/Legends|reactors]]. If its reactors were destroyed, Skytop Station's [[Repulsorlift generator/Legends|repulsorlift generators]] would be compromised, which would consequently plummet the battlesphere to Ruusan 2's surface. While Skywalker left to rescue R2-D2 on his own, Rex, Tano, and their men went to plant explosives at the reactor room thirty levels below, where they found that an alarm had triggered the door's [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shield]]. R3-S6 plugged into a terminal and tried to bypass the shield, but as time went on, Rex became doubtful of R3-S6's abilities and questioned them. Though Tano admonished him, telling him to be patient, R3-S6 was actually stalling to give a battle droid patrol time to ambush the Republic team. The astromech droid's efforts succeeded when a squad of B1 battle droids reached their location and attacked them. While Tano deflected laser shots with her [[Ahsoka Tano's lightsabers/Legends|lightsaber]], Rex and his men used the hallway's supports as cover and opened fire on the battle droids.
