[[File:Rex_lashes_out.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Rex attacks his Zygerrian captors in the original comic.]] The aftermath of the rescue on Kadavo was also modified from the comic's version for the episode. In the comic, Rex and the others spend four more rotations evacuating the Togruta, after which they prepare to destroy the processing hub. As Rex is about to detonate charges placed in the facility, Supreme Chancellor Palpatine contacts them and orders that the facility be preserved for future Republic use. The Jedi disagree with the order, and Rex proceeds with eradicating the complex. Upon being returned to Kiros, the Togruta forsake their pacifistic ways to learn how to defend themselves, and Rex is among the clone troopers who educate them in blaster combat. In the episode's portrayal of the events, Koon's aerial forces demolish the Kadavo complex during the battle. Rex and the others debrief aboard Koon's Star Destroyer, but the episode does not include the Togrutas' return to Kiros. ===Non-canon history=== The following details stories that were not deemed canon within ''Star Wars'' Legends due to their disregard for established continuity. ====''Star Wars Miniatures'' advertisement==== {{Quote|What are we up to ''now'', 64? 65?''"
"''Who ''knows'' what'll happen next?|Rex and Ahsoka Tano, after defeating Grievous|[[Star Wars Miniatures: The Clone Wars advertisement|''Star Wars Miniatures: The Clone Wars'' advertisement]]}} In an [[Star Wars Miniatures: The Clone Wars advertisement|advertisement]] for the ''Star Wars Miniatures: The Clone Wars'' set, Rex and Ahsoka Tano defeat the bounty hunter [[Durge/Legends|Durge]] with a squad of clone troopers and a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]]. When General Grievous appears, Rex and his comrades quickly incapacitate the cyborg, severing several of his limbs with blasterfire. Walking away from their victory, Rex questions how many orders they have been given, since they are nearing directive number sixty-six. ====LEGO ''Star Wars'' online material==== {{Quote|This is Captain Rex reporting in. We've encountered heavy resistance, but the mission is proceeding as planned. …Or not.|Rex, as an OG-9 spider droid appears|{{LEGOWeb|subdomain=starwars|url=en-us/Comics/comic2.aspx|text="Sith make the best pancakes"|int=Sith make the best pancakes|nolive=1}}}} In the LEGO ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' online comic series, Rex and a squad of clone troopers are assigned to undertake a mission, but battle droids shoot down their LAAT/i gunship on a desert planet. Just as Rex reports that the mission is proceeding as planned, several B1 battle droids and an [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|OG-9 homing spider droid]] ambush them. After the spider droid knocks over Rex, he and his troops open fire on the droids. While the other troopers attack the droid menace, Rex finds a clone trooper from [[Batch 82-4]] who is avoiding the battle due to his arachnophobia, a trait specific to his batch. The spider droid charges at Rex and the trooper, and the two take refuge in the remains of the gunship. Rex explains to the scared trooper that it is a droid, not an actual spider, and he watches as the soldier takes up arms and defeats the spider droid single-handed. As Rex congratulates his men on their victory, three more spider droids appear. [[File:Rex_blocks_the_Death_Brick.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Rex blocks the Jedi from the "Death Brick."]] Rex joins Skywalker, Tano, Kenobi, and Rotta the Huttlet in a search for Asajj Ventress. Their team's AT-TE walker finds a squad of IG-100 MagnaGuards and their [[Rogue-class Porax-38 starfighter/Legends|''Rogue''-class starfighter]] on a planet,{{LEGOWeb|subdomain=starwars|url=en-us/Comics/comic2.aspx|text="Sith make the best pancakes"|int=Sith make the best pancakes|nolive=1}} but a B2 super battle droid and several [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|IG-227 ''Hailfire''-class droid tanks]] arrive and blast the walker off its feet. Emerging from their damaged vehicle, Rex, Tano, and Kenobi fight the new arrivals while Skywalker battles the MagnaGuards at the landing platform. Ventress appears with the [[Death Brick]] weapon and throws it at the three Jedi before escaping with the battle droids. Rex jumps into the line of fire and blocks the brick, which simply bounces off his head harmlessly. Commander Cody lands in the vicinity with an LAAT/i gunship and transports Rex, Skywalker, Tano, and Kenobi away from the planet.{{LEGOWeb|subdomain=starwars|url=en-us/Comics/comic7.aspx|text="That's no Space Station"|int=That's no Space Station|sw_url=video/view/000890.html|nolive=1}} Rex is later sent with Kenobi, Cody, and a detachment of clone troopers to rescue Skywalker and Tano in a space battle,{{LEGOWeb|subdomain=starwars|url=en-us/Comics/comicj10.aspx|text="Every brick has a beginning"|int=Every brick has a beginning|sw_url=video/view/000893.html|nolive=1}} but a Separatist tractor beam pulls the group to the surface of a nearby planet.{{LEGOWeb|subdomain=starwars|url=en-US/comics/default.aspx|text="Spinning isn't Always a Good Trick"|int=Spinning isn't Always a Good Trick|sw_url=video/view/000892.html|nolive=1}} R2-D2 is able to open the door of Rex's gunship—which has been jammed from the crash—in time, and Rex arrives with Plo Koon to save Skywalker, Tano, Kenobi, Cody, and their squad of troops from Ventress and an army of battle droids. The Separatists are repelled, and Rex reports R2-D2's actions to Kenobi. Rex is present when Koon is given an award for his valiant efforts in the battle. Later, aboard Supreme Chancellor Palpatine's ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer, Rex and Cody are present when Palpatine fires a clone scout squad in person for their incompetence and failure to find a missing R2-D2.{{LEGOWeb|subdomain=starwars|url=en-us/Comics/Player/2009-7.aspx|text="All good clones must come to an end"|int=All good clones must come to an end|nolive=1}} Rex also accompanies Skywalker to Orto Plutonia when the Separatists stage an attack there. Traveling to the surface with Skywalker and several other clone soldiers in containers carrying Freeco bikes, Rex and his comrades defeat the droid infantry on the planet.{{LEGOWeb|subdomain=starwars|url=en-us/Comics/Player/2010-2.aspx|text="Day 38: The Frozen Planet of Orto Plutonia"|int=Day 38: The Frozen Planet of Orto Plutonia|nolive=1}} In [[LEGO Star Wars: The Quest for R2-D2 (film)|''The Quest for R2-D2'' short film]], Palpatine personally dispatches Rex and Cody to find R2-D2, who has gone missing in action. On an ice planet, the two clone officers lead a patrol and encounter a squad of B1 and B2 battle droids along with an OG-9 spider droid and an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]]. Skidding across the ice, Cody drops a projectile, and Rex swings at the piece with his blaster. The projectile cuts through the droids and hits the AT-AT walker, collapsing it onto the spider droid and overturning a nearby [[NR-N99 Persuader-class droid enforcer/Legends|NR-N99 ''Persuader''-class droid enforcer]]. With their enemies neutralized, the two clones build a ''Nu''-class attack shuttle from the rubble. Rex and Cody then join Skywalker and Tano in raiding a Separatist ''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ship, where they rescue R2-D2 from Grievous, Ventress, and Count Dooku. As Rex and the others prepare to face off against the Separatists, Yoda and Kenobi arrive. Yoda uses the Force to collapse the floor beneath Dooku, Grievous, and Ventress, sending them into space, and also forms a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]]. Rex and his comrades uses the craft to escape from the Droid Control Ship shortly before it explodes. Following the victory, Rex and Cody accompany the Jedi to the "Skywalker World" theme park.[[LEGO Star Wars: The Quest for R2-D2 (film)|''LEGO Star Wars: The Quest for R2-D2'' film]] Rex is also featured in the film's [[LEGO Star Wars: The Quest for R2-D2 (video game)|tie-in online game]], in which he serves as one of the clone trooper enemies for the game's two playable Separatist characters, Dooku and Ventress.{{LEGOWeb|subdomain=starwars|url=en-US/funandgames/Clonewars.aspx|text=LEGO ''Star Wars'': The Quest for R2-D2|int=LEGO Star Wars: The Quest for R2-D2 (video game)|nolive=1}} In the "[[Light side of the Force/Legends|Light Side]]" campaign of [[LEGO Star Wars: The Yoda Chronicles (video game)|''The Yoda Chronicles'' game]], Rex is one of the clone troopers who is made available as an in-game asset to defeat enemies. The only level in which he is offered is the final Coruscant level, in which the player, as Mace Windu, must open the Jedi Archives' [[Holocron Vault/Legends|Holocron Vault]] and defeat Grievous within. The player can purchase up to four copies of Rex at one of the level's build points; he is the most expensive clone trooper, with the cheaper ones being a standard trooper and a 501st trooper. However, using him is not required.[[LEGO Star Wars: The Yoda Chronicles (video game)|''LEGO Star Wars: The Yoda Chronicles'' video game]] ====Cartoon Network online games==== {{Quote|Rex, ol' buddy, I've found your droid poppers.''"
"''Nice work, sir. We'll take it from here.|Anakin Skywalker and Rex in ''Path of the Jedi''|{{CN|url=tv_shows/starwars/games/game_02_ext.html|text=''Path of the Jedi''|int=Path of the Jedi (video game)}}}} [[File:RexAhsoka-PathOfTheJedi.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Rex requests reinforcements from Ahsoka Tano in the "Shadow of Grievous" campaign.]] Rex was featured in several online games on CartoonNetwork.com, all of which are no longer available. In [[Path of the Jedi (video game)|''Path of the Jedi'']], the player could choose to play as either Anakin Skywalker, Ahsoka Tano, or Yoda. In the "Assassin's Snare" campaign, which adapted the first season episode "[[Cloak of Darkness]]," Rex and his men are fighting a detachment of Separatist battle droids aboard a Republic cruiser when the clone troopers are cut off from their heavy weapons storage. If the player is playing as Tano, Skywalker sends her to retrieve the soldiers' electromagnetic pulse grenades from behind enemy lines. If the player chooses Yoda, then a clone trooper sends Yoda on the mission; if Skywalker is chosen, then Kenobi dispatches him on the assignment. After being rearmed with their supply of droid poppers, Rex and his troops make short work of the opposing battle droids. In the "Shadow of Grievous" campaign, which adapted the events of the episode "Duel of the Droids," Rex and a squad of his troops are defending a Republic medical station from the Separatists but are gradually outnumbered by the enemy forces. Depending on the player's selected character, Skywalker, Tano, or Yoda cuts through the battle droids and rescues Rex and his men. In Cartoon Network's ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Game Creator]]'', Rex was one of five characters whom players could use while designing their own online games. The game system allowed players to both create their own games and play those developed by others.{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091012/index.html|text=Cartoon Network Launches ''Star Wars'' Game Creator Online}} Rex's "Power Attack" in the game was launching landmines.{{CN|subdomain=starwarsgamecreator|url=index.html|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Game Creator|int=Star Wars: The Clone Wars Game Creator}} In the ''[[Galaxy of Heroes]]'' game, Rex was one of the playable characters in various shooting-style missions. Armed with only his blaster pistols, Rex must first defeat all opposing forces at a battle droid compound. He is then given an AT-TE walker to pilot and is tasked with destroying an enemy base, cutting through missile turrets, droid-manned STAPs, and laser emplacements to achieve his objective.{{CN|url=games/star-wars/galaxy-of-heroes/index.html|text=''Galaxy of Heroes''|int=Galaxy of Heroes}} ====Clone Wars Infinities==== [[File:KoonBriefing-Citadel.png|thumb|left|300px|In the Infinities storyline, Rex, Cody, and their comrades fail to even reach the Citadel.]] In the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Magazine 2|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars Magazine'' 2]]{{'s}} [[Infinities]] version of the second season episode "[[Brain Invaders]]," brain worms infect both trooper [[Scythe (clone trooper)/Legends|Scythe]] and Commander Cody in the wake of the Second Battle of Geonosis. While Ahsoka Tano and Kit Fisto contain Scythe and other infected troopers, Cody spreads the parasite among the Republic fleet. Rex, Anakin Skywalker, and Obi-Wan Kenobi all fall victim to the worms, which reach the Jedi Order and the Republic government on Coruscant. Only Tano, Fisto, and Barriss Offee have the knowledge to contain the worms, but with the whole of the Republic at the worms' mercy, time begins to run out for the uninfected Jedi.[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Magazine 2|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars Magazine'' 2]] In the Infinities version of the third season episode "The Citadel," as presented in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.20|Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic UK 6.20]]'', Rex, Skywalker, Tano, Kenobi, and their men are frozen in carbonite as planned to rescue Even Piell from the Citadel. When R2-D2 transports the elite team to the prison, a rogue [[Mass shadow/Legends|hyperspace shadow]] collides with their shuttle, sending them off-course and shorting out R2-D2's circuits. While Rex and his comrades drift in space, locked in perfect hibernation, the Republic is replaced with the first Galactic Empire under the leadership of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]-for-life Palpatine. Almost twenty years after their unintentional detour, Rex and the team are found by Bail Organa and other members of the fledgling [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and are taken to the planet [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] to be unfrozen. Although shocked to learn of the intervening events over the last two decades, the Jedi join the Rebel Alliance in resisting the Imperial regime.[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.20|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic 6.20]] ====''LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars''==== [[File:Rex-LSW3.png|thumb|right|200px|Rex, as he appears in ''LEGO Star Wars'']] Rex is featured in numerous levels of the multi-platform game ''LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars''. In addition to his trademark blaster pistols, the game's mechanics give him the use of a grapple gun and [[Shock grenade/Legends|shock grenades]], as well as the ability to command clone troopers during assault levels.[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars: Prima Official Game Guide|''LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars'': Prima Official Game Guide]] The game's story-based levels, which humorously adapt a number of first and second season episodes, are organized into three main campaigns, each of which focuses on Count Dooku, General Grievous, or Asajj Ventress. Rex is a playable character in the level for the first season episode "[[Blue Shadow Virus (episode)|Blue Shadow Virus]]," which is part of Ventress's campaign. In the Grievous storyline, Rex is incorporated into the levels adapting "Duel of the Droids" and "Rookies," while he is also featured in the "[[Weapons Factory]]" level within the Dooku campaign. He is unlocked for "Free Play" mode following the completion of the first level in which he appears within each campaign's "Story" mode. In addition, he is one of the playable characters for the epilogue level of "Story" mode, "The Zillo Beast." In the game's "Republic Assault" mode, four levels feature Rex as one of the two Republic commanders whom the player can control: Saleucami and the Rishi moon, alongside another clone trooper; and the Ruusan moon and the third moon of Vassek, along with Commander Cody. In "Separatist Assault," Rex acts as one of the enemy commanders in five levels: the third moon of Vassek, the Rishi moon, the Ruusan moon, [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]], and Christophsis. ====''Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Head-to-Head''==== As part of the non-canon matchups presented in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Head-to-Head]]'', Rex is pitted against a deadly Separatist [[Infiltrator/Demolition droid]], which disguises itself as a common sweeper droid to attack Coruscant's [[Central power distribution grid/Legends|power generator complex]]. Bringing along a clone trooper security team, Rex is the first on the scene at the power generator and intercepts the demolition droid, which quickly expands into combat mode. He leaps behind some cover to evade the droid's arm-mounted laser cannons, returning fire with his twin blaster pistols. Ultimately, his precision in marksmanship saves the day: He prevents the demolition droid from arming itself as a bomb, dislodging its explosive charge from its housing. He then manages to disable the droid beyond repair with more blasterfire. The storyline closely mirrors the events of the third season episode "[[Heroes on Both Sides]]," in which a team of Separatist demolition droids execute a [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid/Legends|bombing]] of Coruscant's power generator. Whereas the droids are successful in the episode,{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}} the demolition droid fails its mission in ''Head-to-Head'' due to Rex's intervention. ==Appearances== {{ScrollBox|content=
